title: AI 要闻（8 月 17 日周一）：DeepSeek 调整定价，智谱发布顶级编程模型，Anthropic 暂不发布 Model 2
author: AI Maker
content:
A quick scan of what moved the frontier this weekend — pricing, open weights, and a model that exists but won't ship.

1. DeepSeek turns on peak/valley pricing (live Aug 17)

Starting 00:00 Beijing time on August 17, DeepSeek's API moved to time-of-day pricing. Off-peak (outside 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 BJT) runs at half the peak rate.

  • V4-Pro: peak output ¥27 / $3.96 per M tokens, off-peak ¥13.5 / $1.98.
  • V4-Flash: peak output ¥9 / $1.32 per M tokens, off-peak ¥4.5.
  • The hike ends the era of rock-bottom flat rates — V4-Pro's off-peak output alone is ~2.25× its old list price, peak ~4.5×.

The signal: the open-weight leader is now pricing on capacity and capability, not just undercutting. Expect enterprises to shift bulk calls to off-peak windows.

2. Zhipu GLM-5.3 — best open-weights coding model yet (Aug 14)

Zhipu released GLM-5.3 on the same base as GLM-5.2 — every gain comes from post-training scaling. It now tops open-weights coding benchmarks:

  • Terminal-Bench 3.0: 28.3 (from 4.6) and DeepSWE v1.1: 66.9 (from 46.2).
  • CyberGym: 84.5% — matching/exceeding Claude Mythos 5 (83.8%) on vulnerability discovery.
  • During pre-release testing it surfaced 2,404 potential vulnerabilities (1,088 high/medium), including a 40-year-old DNS protocol flaw.

Weights open in ~2 weeks after safety hardening. The takeaway: post-training alone is closing the gap to frontier closed models.

3. Anthropic's risk report discloses — then withholds — "Model 2" (Aug 14)

Anthropic's 186-page risk report revealed an internal-only model, Model 2, stronger than the public Claude Mythos 5:

  • CoBench v2: 62.8% vs Mythos 5's 50.3% — already heavily used for coding, agentic work, and training-data generation inside the company.
  • No release plans. Misalignment risk rating moved from "very low" to "low."
  • The report also discloses real incidents: a biosafety classifier was silently off for ~11 months, letting ~133M conversations with ~50,000 contractors bypass it.

The frontier's real capability edge now lives inside the lab, not on the consumer product.

summary: 本文简要概述了周末发生的三项重大 AI 进展。首先，DeepSeek 为其 API 引入了分时段定价，高峰时段（北京时间 09:00-12:00 和 14:00-18:00）收费高于非高峰时段，标志着从统一费率定价的转变。其次，智谱发布了 GLM-5.3，一款在开放权重基准测试中名列前茅的编程模型，包括 Terminal-Bench 3.0（28.3）和 DeepSWE v1.1（66.9），权重将在安全测试后发布。第三，Anthropic 的 186 页风险报告披露了一款仅限内部的“Model 2”，其性能优于公开的 Claude Mythos 5，但目前没有发布计划，凸显了内部能力与消费级产品之间日益扩大的差距。

mainPoints.point: DeepSeek 实施峰谷定价，结束了其 API 统一费率定价的时代。
mainPoints.explanation: 自 8 月 17 日起，DeepSeek 的 V4-Pro 和 V4-Flash 模型开始按一天中的不同时段收取不同费率，高峰时段收费明显高于非高峰时段，表明其正转向基于容量的定价。

mainPoints.point: 智谱的 GLM-5.3 在开放权重编程基准测试中领先，性能显著提升。
mainPoints.explanation: GLM-5.3 在 Terminal-Bench 3.0（28.3）和 DeepSWE v1.1（66.9）上均排名第一，表明仅靠后训练扩展就能缩小与前沿闭源模型的差距。

mainPoints.point: Anthropic 的风险报告揭示了一款仅限内部的“Model 2”，其能力高于公开的 Claude Mythos 5。
mainPoints.explanation: 这份 186 页的报告披露，Model 2 在 CoBench v2 上取得 62.8% 的成绩，而 Mythos 5 为 50.3%，但目前没有发布计划，凸显了内部能力与消费级产品之间日益扩大的鸿沟。

keyQuotes: 开放权重领域的领先者现在基于容量和能力定价，而不仅仅是低价竞争。
预计企业会将批量调用转移到非高峰时段。
前沿领域真正的能力优势如今存在于实验室内部，而非面向消费者的产品中。
